blocks.text: The assembled chiefs debate how Banda may be undone, speaking of paras-like powers, hidden wealth, and occult advantage as though ordinary battle might not suffice.
They imagine capture, trickery, and forced disclosure, hoping to seize Banda alive and extract the source of his strength before he grows harder to confront.
By centering paras and secret power, the page shows the fear and superstition that already surround Banda in the hill country.
